documentation.content:
## Runbook: checkout-api fast burn

- **Dashboard**: https://console.cloud.google.com/monitoring/dashboards/custom/PLACEHOLDER
- **Owner**: team-checkout (@checkout-oncall)
- **Playbook**: 1) check recent deploys (Cloud Run revisions last 2h). 2) rollback via `gcloud run services update-traffic`. 3) look at traces in Cloud Trace for 5xx spans. 4) escalate to platform if infra-wide.
- **Why this fires**: consuming 2% of the 30d error budget in the last 60m. SLI = non-5xx request ratio.
